summary: Tested Media Library feature end-to-end. Backend: 5/5 pytest tests passing (auth guards, upload->list->delete flow, field structure, is_video flag, 404 on non-existent). Frontend: login+MFA, /media page renders with empty state and grid, ImageUpload Library button (bg-media-lib) opens dialog listing user media (lib-item-*), picking sets field to media URL, uploading via bg-media-file adds to library, Media page Copy/Delete buttons work (media-copy-{id}, media-del-{id}) and delete removes the card. No regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: ImageUpload delLib should also remove the URL from the currently-selected value if it matches the deleted media (currently only removes it from the library grid; the bg-media input still points to a deleted S3 object). Minor UX issue.
MediaLibrary.jsx: fmtSize returns '1 KB' for tiny files (fine); consider showing content-type badge and created_at.

Backend delete_media swallows S3 delete failures silently (only logs). Consider surfacing partial failure so orphaned S3 objects don't accumulate — currently it still deletes the DB record even if S3 fails.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 temp PNG upload via S3 and deleted it at end of test; also 1 mp4 stub in pytest (cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Media library backend endpoints: POST /api/uploads inserts db.media, GET /api/media (auth) lists newest-first with _id excluded, DELETE /api/media/{id} deletes S3 object + record (404 otherwise). Frontend: nav has 'Media' -> /media (MediaLibrary.jsx). ImageUpload renders {testid}-lib button + Dialog listing lib-item-{id} / lib-del-{id}. bg-media-file is a hidden input; use set_input_files for playwright uploads. Scenes list uses 'Edit' buttons (no anchor links) to open editor at /scenes/{id}. tests: /app/backend/tests/test_media.py
